The required full-suite check holding https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/pull/635 failed on the first attempt in the unchanged `testRejectedDrainLoggingDoesNotHoldOutboxMonitor`. The owner requested local reproduction and a source fix rather than a CI rerun; the failure is at https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/actions/runs/40085745929/job/120848195951.

**Do not merge: awaiting approval of https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/commit/dd22e57d69bd26d39453d143b5f558fa52180ff4.** This isolated final proposal waits for the test's already-counted injected queue tasks before ordinary host cleanup. It adds one assertion and changes no existing assertion, iteration count, timeout, or tested monitor behavior. It is needed because a close command can itself be rejected while that deliberately filled queue is still full.

The underlying timeout is fixed upstream at https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/jvm-libp2p/pull/71. `NettyExt.toCompletableFuture` added a listener even to an already-completed close promise. A full live event-loop queue rejected its notification, leaving the Java future pending after recovery. Both future converters now copy terminal results directly and recheck completion after registration. The original Netty warning's “Event loop shut down?” wording did not mean the root worker loop had shut down.

This branch pins `community.kotlin.libp2p:jvm-libp2p:1.3.0-codexcoder21-snapshot-41`, adds a permanent deterministic loopback host-stop guard, and retains the 128-cycle/eight-worker amplifier. The pin is ready once that version is published; no artifact was published or deployed in this work. The first commit carries the exact version change; the final commit contains only the owner-held original-test proposal.

Local records:
- Clone-time main: unchanged original first attempt passed 1/1; amplified batches failed 3/3 with 16/128, 13/128 and 23/128 failed cycles.
- Exact PR control `1985947cb3ce49a983e321e7721debc34eae5138`: same amplifier failed 3/3 with 18/128, 24/128 and 16/128 failed cycles. These samples do not demonstrate a PR-caused rate difference.
- Deterministic downstream guard: failed 3/3 with the exact CI converter/transport stack against snapshot-25; passed against the locally built fixed library. Upstream guards failed 6/6 before the change and on explicit reversal, then passed with 17 neighboring cases (23/23 total), including after restoring the fix.
- Direct comparison with the cleanup proposal: original and deterministic guard passed 2/2. The amplified run had zero host-stop timeouts and zero rejected-close failures, but one of 128 cycles failed during connection setup with `ExecutionException(NonCompleteException(CompletionException(SocketException: Connection reset)))`. This remains unattributed and must be investigated before treating the amplified run as green.
- Normal local scripts attempts encountered unpublished-dependency resolution during preparation; they are recorded separately from test-body results. No CI check was rerun, requested or watched.

Full first-attempt failures, attempt histories, scripts, source snapshots and findings are on https://github.com/CodexCoder21Organization/UrlProtocol/tree/wip/FL635-20261024/investigation/FL635 . This draft remains held for the proposal approval, library publication, and remaining probe failure.
